violation_type.title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Accommodations (26 TAC §747.2107(1))
violation_type.short_title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Accommodations
violation_type.typical_finding: During the inspection staff were unable to provide a curriculum or documentation to demonstrate that an educational or activity plan was in place for the child with special needs.

finding_variants.text: During the inspection staff were unable to provide a curriculum or documentation to demonstrate that an educational or activity plan was in place for the child with special needs.
One child with special care needs didn't have an accommodation plan available during the inspection.
